purpose: One final label-free numerical adequacy audit of a classical active-set Newton forward Bernoulli-KL solver; not a novel method or prediction benchmark
selection: First 64 lexicographic (sha256('projection_audit_v1:'+id), id) pairs; same IDs for all models; no label/score/group stratification
forbidden: No targets, prefix labels, row log loss, row Brier, participant/group outcomes, model fitting or observed-label performance recomputation

solver.name: simplex active-set Newton with vertex admission and Armijo line search
solver.exact_identity: Already coherent q is returned bitwise unchanged. For q inside the clipping domain, compute objective/gradient/FW gap at actual represented p=w@bank, record reconstruction residual, and never hardcode zero gap. Outside the clip domain record identity with no FW certificate.

interpretation: Floating-point convex gap and finite-target checks, not exact or interval-arithmetic certification. Reference timing is per-row; old batch timing is not an equivalent throughput comparison. No best-model conclusion from this audit.
after_completion: Stop regardless of outcome. No third projection audit; return to violin future prediction.
